One Hostel Hanoi features a rooftop swimming pool for guests to enjoy. The hostel lies in Old Quarter where you 'll then have a chance for some shopping and exploration, and the nearest bus stop, to airport number 86, is just 0.6 km away. The Thống Nhất Park is located around a 10-minute ride from this Hanoi hostel and the French Colonial mansion "Presidential Palace" is nearly a 25-minute walk away. Nearby shopping destinations comprise the bustling Hanoi Night Market (0.8 km) and Ba Dinh Historic Square (1.9 km) for visitors to explore. The ornate 11th - century Bach Ma Temple is merely 550 metres away, and the grand classical music hall "Opera House", available to diversify your stay, is 2.1 km away. The 184-room The One Hostel Hanoi provides access to Ha Noi train station, which is approximately a 25-minute walk away. An American breakfast is served daily at the Hanoi accommodation. Guests can enjoy a vegan restaurant on site.
